message.content: Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller or simpler version of that same problem. The function includes a **base case**, which stops the calling chain so the process doesn’t run forever. Each recursive call works toward that base case, gradually breaking the problem down until it can be solved directly. By combining the results of each call, the original problem is solved.
